dogecoin.text: Elon doesn’t represent #dogecoin or what the movement stands for. He can’t even explain anything substantive about it.

#dogecoin is good.
Cost of living is worse than ever partly because of the US dollar. So if that bothers you, you can invest in another currency with less inflation, with the hope it becomes the global standard. With some class solidarity behind this, we can do it.

I think some whales (owners of a lot of coins) might have sold off, which is great. That will help with circulation & supply. Robinhood is crashing so #dogecoin hasn’t had the chance to recover much. It’s all good!
Tesla & what they do with crypto is the decider. Elon’s tweets won’t affect the market much from here. #dogecoin
